notes.title: Variety in the Passenger Jobs
notes.notes: Added a bit of variety in the passenger job to avoid making tasks repetitive.

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes
notes.notes: Added few more elements to the Open world and resolved some UI bugs.

notes.title: Release Version
notes.notes: Final Release of the Game. More updates coming up soon. Hope you enjoy it.

notes.title: Added Partial Controller Support and minor changes.
notes.notes: Controller Support for Vehicle has been added.

notes.title: Minor menu bug fix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where mouse cursor would not show up on the menu if connected to a controller/save game was corrupted.

notes.title: Improvements to UI and controls
notes.notes:
Added a few UI elements and controls in order to make it easier for a fresh player to identify the controls and key bindings. 
Added a photo mode. 
Sneak peek into the areas that will be newly added with the next patch.

notes.title: More user friendly UI for new starters
notes.notes: [b]Made substantial changes in some of the UI to give directions to the players newly loading up the game. Thanks for the honest reviews that were given and hope to receive more constructive feedback. [/b]

notes.title: Patched a bug for Post Office Missions
notes.notes: Patched a bug where the maximum number of randomly generated missions for the daily post office missions was locked to 3.
